notes: The twelve elemental hero spells, grouped by element. Descriptions are short paraphrases; check your spell cards for exact effects.

records.name: Genie
records.description: Summon a genie to open a door or attack a monster.

records.name: Swift Wind
records.description: A hero moves farther on their next move.

records.name: Tempest
records.description: A whirlwind makes a monster miss its next turn.

records.name: Heal Body
records.description: Restore lost Body Points to a hero.

records.name: Pass Through Rock
records.description: A hero may move through walls on their next move.

records.name: Rock Skin
records.description: A hero defends with an extra die until wounded.

records.name: Ball of Flame
records.description: Hurl fire at a monster to wound it.

records.name: Courage
records.description: A hero attacks with extra dice while monsters are visible.

records.name: Fire of Wrath
records.description: A direct magical attack against one monster.

records.name: Veil of Mist
records.description: A hero moves unseen past monsters on their next move.

records.name: Water of Healing
records.description: Restore lost Body Points to a hero.
